title: Planetarium: A Rigorous Benchmark for Translating Text to Structured Planning Languages
authors_zh: Max Zuo, Francisco Piedrahita Velez, Xiaochen Li, Michael L. Littman, Stephen H. Bach
paper_type_zh: 语义验证的 text-to-PDDL 基准
best_for_zh: 研究文本规划、PDDL 生成或可验证奖励的研究者。
one_line: Planetarium pairs four textual descriptions with planning problems and uses object-renaming-aware PDDL equivalence to distinguish solvable outputs from semantically correct ones.
Planetarium 以对象重命名不变的 PDDL 语义等价检查，区分可求解的规划输出与真正表达同一初始状态和目标的输出。
why: It shows that executable plans can encode the wrong problem and makes semantic verification directly reusable for text-to-PDDL training and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Planetarium releases text-to-PDDL records with a programmatic semantic-equivalence contract stronger than parsing or planner success.

title: Problem
问题
html: A natural-language-to-PDDL output may parse and admit a plan while encoding the wrong initial state or goal, so executability does not imply semantic fidelity. Earlier datasets also often paraphrase PDDL templates too directly, making the task easy. Planetarium introduces a rigorous PDDL semantic-equivalence algorithm and a large text-to-PDDL dataset with multiple description styles, separating syntax validity, solvability, and genuine semantic correctness.
自然语言到 PDDL 的模型输出即使语法可解析、规划器能找到解，也可能描述了错误的初始状态或目标，因此“可运行”并不能代表与原问题语义一致。旧数据又常直接把 PDDL 模板转成近似复述，难度偏低。Planetarium 提出严格的 PDDL 语义等价算法，并构建大规模、多表述的 text-to-PDDL 数据，以区分语法合法、可求解和真正语义正确三层能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The final NAACL version contains 145,918 text–PDDL pairs over Blocks World and Gripper, 73 unique state combinations, and varying difficulty. Each ground-truth PDDL problem has four language styles: fully abstract, fully explicit, and two mixed descriptions. The verifier parses candidates, checks solvability, and then tests semantic equivalence under object renaming and state/goal correspondence. The current Hugging Face release expands representations to about 584K rows, which should not be confused with the paper’s independent pair count.

正式 NAACL 版本包含 145,918 个文本—PDDL 对，覆盖 Blocks World 与 Gripper、73 种唯一状态组合及不同难度。每个 ground-truth PDDL 配四类自然语言：完全抽象、完全显式以及两种混合描述。验证器先解析候选，再判断问题可求解，最后通过对象重命名和状态/目标对应检查语义等价。当前 Hugging Face 页面按多种表示展开约 58.4 万行，不能与论文的独立 pair 数直接等同。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Design planning templates: Define combinatorial rules for objects, initial states, and goals in Blocks World and Gripper.
  1. Generate instances programmatically: Enumerate or sample state combinations, produce solvable ground-truth PDDL, and create four natural-language styles for each problem.
  1. Build equivalence checking: Parse candidate PDDL, validate types and predicates, search allowed object mappings, and compare initial-state and goal sets.
  1. Score hierarchically: Record parseability, solvability, and semantic correctness separately. Reproduction must fix the PDDL subset, planner, renaming rules, dataset version, and random seeds.

1. 设计规划模板： 在 Blocks World 与 Gripper 中定义对象、初始状态和目标的组合规则。
  1. 程序生成实例： 枚举或采样状态组合，产生可求解 ground-truth PDDL，并为每题生成四种自然语言描述。
  1. 建立等价算法： 解析候选 PDDL，验证类型与谓词，再搜索允许的对象映射，比较初始状态和目标集合。
  1. 分层评分： 分别记录 parseable、solvable 和 semantically correct。复现需固定 PDDL 子集、planner、对象重命名规则、数据版本和生成随机种子。

title: Evidence
证据
html: In the final setting, 96.1% of GPT-4o outputs are parseable and 94.4% are solvable, yet only 24.8% are semantically equivalent to the reference. The large gap directly shows that parsers or planners alone substantially overestimate ability. Similar patterns appear across open and API models, with abstract descriptions generally harder. This supports the need for equivalence checking, but the findings cover only STRIPS, Blocks World, and Gripper rather than full PDDL.

在正式设置中，GPT-4o 生成的 PDDL 有 96.1% 可解析、94.4% 可求解，但只有 24.8% 与参考语义等价。三个数字之间的巨大差距直接证明，仅用 parser 或 planner 会严重高估模型能力。多种开源和 API 模型均呈现类似现象，且抽象描述通常更难。该证据支持等价验证器的必要性，但结论只覆盖 STRIPS、Blocks World 与 Gripper，不能自动推广到完整 PDDL。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier PDDL-generation evaluations usually check syntax or planner solvability and cannot detect outputs that are solvable but encode a different problem. Planetarium introduces an object-name-invariant yet state-and-goal-strict semantic-equivalence contract and gives each formal problem language descriptions at different abstraction levels. The changed components are the verifier and language surface, not a new planner.
已有 PDDL 生成评测通常检查语法或能否由 planner 求解，无法识别“可解但问题被改写”的输出。Planetarium 的新意是定义对对象命名不敏感、却严格比较状态与目标的语义等价契约，并让同一形式问题拥有抽象程度不同的自然语言。变化点是 verifier 和语言表面，而不是新增规划算法。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Domain scope: The current data covers only two classic domains and the STRIPS subset, excluding numeric fluents, temporal planning, and complex action effects.
  1. Template distribution: Programmatically generated descriptions may retain learnable template cues, so high scores do not imply understanding of real user planning language.
  1. Equivalence complexity: Object-mapping search grows with problem size, and behaviorally equivalent alternative domain encodings may not be accepted. Extensions require human semantic audits.

1. 领域范围： 当前数据只覆盖两个经典域和 STRIPS 子集，缺少数值 fluent、时间规划和复杂 action effects。
  1. 模板分布： 程序生成描述仍可能留下可学习的模板痕迹，模型高分不等于理解真实用户规划语言。
  1. 等价复杂度： 对象映射搜索在更大问题中成本上升，且不同但行为等价的域级编码未必被当前规则接受。扩展时需增加人工语义审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluate text-to-PDDL: Report parseability, solvability, and semantic equivalence together rather than planner success alone.
  1. Train verifiable generators: Use PDDL-equivalence outcomes for SFT filtering or binary RLVR rewards.
  1. Build new planning domains: Reuse the four-description, programmatic-generation, and object-mapping-equivalence pipeline for other STRIPS domains. Full PDDL, continuous variables, or interactive environments require a new verifier rather than direct reuse.

1. 评测 text-to-PDDL： 同时报告可解析率、可求解率和语义等价率，避免只看 planner 成功。
  1. 训练可验证生成器： 将 PDDL 等价结果作为 SFT 过滤或 RLVR 二值奖励。
  1. 构造新规划域： 复用“四种描述—程序生成—对象映射等价”流程扩展其他 STRIPS 域。若任务使用完整 PDDL、连续变量或环境交互，应重新实现 verifier，不能直接套用现有等价算法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Planetarium uses 145,918 text-to-PDDL pairs to show that solvability is far from semantic correctness.
  2. Method takeaway: State templates, four language styles, object renaming, and initial/goal equivalence checking.
  3. Data takeaway: About 584K HF rows are expanded representations; the paper reports 145,918 independent pairs.
  4. Evidence anchor: GPT-4o is 96.1% parseable, 94.4% solvable, but only 24.8% equivalent.
  5. Reuse decision: It fits STRIPS text-to-PDDL, but equivalence rules must be redesigned for new domains.

1. 一句话定位： Planetarium 用 145,918 个 text-to-PDDL 对证明“可解”远不等于“语义正确”。
  2. 方法抓手： 状态模板、四种语言表述、对象重命名和状态/目标等价检查。
  3. 数据抓手： HF 约 58.4 万行是展开表示，论文独立 pair 数为 145,918。
  4. 证据锚点： GPT-4o 96.1% 可解析、94.4% 可解、仅 24.8% 等价。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 STRIPS text-to-PDDL；扩域前必须重做等价规则。
